govbr-3.7.0-page-global-f6e03bce515b.justificativa: Catch-all adherence to the whole standard; no single observable.

govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-1ccbc61.justificativa: Header cells as td, or th without scope. Measure: thead cell tagName and scope.

Header cells stay th but lose scope.

govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-cd705eb.justificativa: Canonical table example carries a caption; remove it. Measure: caption element inside the table.

govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-5be1f55.justificativa: Modal opens without receiving focus, or closes without returning it. Measure: activeElement after opening and after closing.

govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-2f22b72.justificativa: Same observable: a native element replaced by div/span.
